summary: An account settings page in three sections, profile, notifications and preferences, with a save bar that appears once anything changes.

props.name: description
props.default: Your profile and how Files keeps in touch.

props.name: defaultValues
props.description: What the form starts with, and what Discard goes back to.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Called with every value when Save is pressed. The save bar shows a spinner until the promise settles, then goes away.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the selects' menus are portalled. Leave unset to portal into `document.body`; pass an element to keep them inside a scrolling frame.
